description:
About this book

Frodo Baggins inherits a ring whose importance reaches far beyond his quiet life among the hobbits. Its former master, Sauron, is gathering power and wants it back. Destroying the ring requires a journey into the enemy's own territory. Frodo must carry that responsibility while the struggle spreads across Middle-earth.

This complete narrative brings together the journeys and conflicts published as The Fellowship of the Ring, The Two Towers and The Return of the King.
